original_card.question: Can one reproducible environment or artifact-comparison failure be repaired?
methods: Reproduce one portability failure and add a minimal cross-environment fix.
Audit one canonical-payload comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Preserve immutable source hashes and proof-relevant content; a different compressed byte stream alone is not a mathematical mismatch.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Reproduce one specific mismatch or audit one canonical comparison for omitted proof-relevant fields.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Portable exact checks prevent environment failures from blocking valid contributions.
allowed_variations: One interpreter/version mismatch or one payload field comparison.
scope_change_triggers: Removing immutable-source pins because generated compressed bytes differ.

actual_scope: Explicit user-assigned P07/G12 follow-up: audit the original allocation-failure guarantee against pinned CPython acquisition, exception capture and delivery paths. Retain finite source counterexamples and the exact conditional next gate.
scope_change_reason: The user assigned the P07/G12 roadblock. The portable-replay card is preserved only as historical provenance. This follow-up identifies source-contract insufficiency, rather than claiming a new multiplication supplier or a generic Python impossibility theorem.
bottleneck_link: Side result on verifier custody, not a supplier. N22/P07 cannot compare a cache candidate with the original reference while the parent and consumer disagree on identity type or a close error can erase the first failure. Selected kappa and the five framework assumptions are unchanged. Complex remains the binding supplier.
stop_rule: Preserve the original CP01-CP15 and known-cleanup obligations. No silent infallible-allocation premise, original runtime replay, budget transfer, adopted source selection, or generic impossibility claim.
evidence: CLAIM.md, immutable source excerpts, and 13 finite transition cases. No target fault injection, import, interpreter build or scientific execution.
author: Chris R / Clear1nsight

open_questions.question: Can the actual pinned interpreter supply raw exception capture and outward-primary delivery at the original observer boundary?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A bounded journal cannot recover an exception not delivered to it, or force the interpreter to propagate the retained primary.
open_questions.first_step: Qualify target implementation correspondence and enumerate capture/handler/call/traceback sites along the unchanged original boundaries; eliminate or prove each remaining site.
open_questions.blocked_by: No target-build correspondence or delivery assurance is established. Any extra runtime premise is an explicit amendment.

open_questions.question: Can acquisition-to-registration be covered without weakening ownership?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The ordinary C-to-Python return conversion can fail after a descriptor is acquired.
open_questions.first_step: Prove either a faithful atomic-owner primitive or a private-descriptor-table prediction/recovery protocol; preserve UNKNOWN on ambiguity.
open_questions.blocked_by: The conversion witness is not a general impossibility proof; no acquisition alternative is implemented or qualified.
